…alignment law

Derives what physical event structure realises a period of N - DELTA rather
than DELTA, from the interleaved program plus a per-station attributed kernel
trace, and generalises Cycle 889's two-run alignment law to k runs in both a
ring and a finite form.

- transport fact: inside a closed quiescent stretch only the four ordered rows
  of an incident edge (h_f = f-2, f, r, h_r = r+2) move a bank's dirt, and a
  pointer-carrying crossing is an exchange across that edge
- bookkeeping identity s2 - s1 = Delta_t + (p2 - p1) classifies every readable
  period: RELAY_EDGE_DELTA / RELAY_EDGE_COMPLEMENT / RELAY_ENTRY_GAP /
  TOKEN_SEPARATION / MIXED
- the complement 8(e+1) is the ENTRY GAP r(b) - f(b-1) = 8(B-1-b) of the single
  bank b = B-2-e; DELTA belongs to an edge, its complement to a bank
- k-run law I_max(P) = (max cyclic gap of W SYMDIFF (W-P)) - 1, verified on a
  declared randomised grid and recovering all 580 of 889's own cells
- derivation at B=4/5, holdout at B=6/7 behind a printed seal computed before
  any holdout corpus exists
